name: IoT Hub message routing
short_description: Azure IoT Hub feature that evaluates rules on message properties to send device-to-cloud messages to built-in or custom endpoints such as Event Hubs, storage or Fabric eventstreams.

evidence.quote: IoT Hub message routing lets you define rules that inspect a message and send matching ones to custom endpoints.
Once a device message enters IoT Hub, message rooting decides which approved downstream path receives it.
Microsoft documents that IoT Hub message routing maintains the order of routed messages.
